## Release Impact

- [ ] This change affects an installable plugin.
- [ ] This change affects marketplace metadata, install policy, release automation, or
  root release policy docs.
- [ ] This change requires a SemVer bump.
- [ ] The relevant changelog has been updated, or this PR has the `no-release` label.
- [ ] Plugin changes were reviewed for schema, grade-sheet contract, validator, skill,
  command, hook, MCP config, executable script, and auth/setup impact.

## Validation

- [ ] `make check`
